acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Gargoyles family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Guardian, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Relief-Dive Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Standing upright figure with carved relief detail, broad functional wings, and glowing amber seams at the joints.
Signature mechanic: Cornice Route: amber seams illuminate shoulder, elbow, and ankle reliefs in order while broad functional wings bank toward the matching dive lane.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a true aerial threat that traces one carved relief route before a broad-wing dive.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 chipped sandstone, tiny useless wings, perch chip, and crude water-spout mouth gain a separate pressure valve; T2 granite, moss, and small wings gain reflective mortar fills; T3 broad wings, carved relief, and amber seams gain spout conduits; T4 marble, bronze, and tracery gain drainage channels; T5 buttress wings, throne, and attendants gain bounded throne cisterns.

Motion/process branches: T1 one short perch drop fills and drains the water-spout valve; T2 a hop with small wings pressurizes one granite mortar seam; T3 the dive with broad wings drives coherent flow through relief conduits; T4 a tracery aisle cycles mist through its bronze drain; T5 each attendant command fills and empties one throne cistern.
counterplay: Track the seam order, cross through the unlit segment, and strike the wing hinge after the dive commits. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the chipped-sandstone perch and tiny wings expose the water-spout valve after pressure loss; T2 the granite moss line and small-wing hinge expose a draining mortar fill after the hop; T3 broad wings and amber relief seams expose the conduit valve after the dive; T4 marble, bronze, and tracery expose the draining channel after an aisle cycle; T5 buttress wings, throne, and attendants expose the commanded throne cistern valve.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating water staining as Water affinity
identityInvariants: Squat crouched construction, hunched shoulders, horned beast face, clawed grip, and folded architectural wings remain recognizable.
Sandstone, granite, marble, bronze, mortar, moss, and water staining remain discrete built materials rather than flesh.
Relief carving, water-spout mouths, restrained amber seams, and pedestal fragments preserve the architectural source grammar.
Stone quality and wing architecture escalate from useless carved flaps to sovereign buttresses while load-bearing joints stay readable.
telegraph: The upright body turns, broad wings lock, and three amber seams light along one carved relief path.
